infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EMS Copilot records patient encounter audio to generate a structured PCR.

extra.note: Use Expo Go (no Mac/Xcode needed) to demo: `expo start`, scan the QR code with the Expo Go app on any iPhone or Android device. EAS Build (cloud-based) is only needed for an installable/TestFlight binary.
extra.assets: assets/*.png are generated from the vector mark in src/components/Logo.js -- see the note at the top of that file.
